name: Ben Dziedzic
title: Analyst
relationship_opened: Cold email, referred by Jon's brother Jared

threads.subject: [Jared Nachman Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in RBC New York

messages.subject: [Jared Nachman Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in RBC New York
messages.body:
Hello Ben,

I hope you are doing well. My name is Jonathan Nachman, and I am Jared Nachman's younger brother. Jared sent over your contact details with me given I'm interested in recruiting with RBC New York. I am currently a sophomore at the University of Texas at Austin and just recently applied to your firm.

I would love the opportunity to briefly chat with you over the phone to learn more about your recruiting experience and time as an analyst with RBC. I am largely free this week and can likely accommodate my schedule to fit yours. Please let me know if this is something you would be willing to do.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: [Jared Nachman Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in RBC New York
messages.body:
Hi Jonathan,

Happy to connect. How does tomorrow at 4:30pm ET sound?

Ben Dziedzic, RBC Capital Markets

messages.subject: Re: [Jared Nachman Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in RBC New York
messages.body:
Hey Ben,

I appreciate you getting back to me - 4:30pm ET works for me. I'll send you a calendar invite. I look forward to speaking with you then.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.subject: RE: [Jared Nachman Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in RBC New York
messages.body:
Thanks can you please give me a ring at the mobile below.

Ben Dziedzic, RBC Capital Markets

messages.subject: Re: [Jared Nachman Referral] UT Austin Student Interested in RBC New York
messages.body:
Hey Ben,

I want to apologize in advance as I am going to go ahead and cancel our call this afternoon. Upon preparing for our chat, I realized I unintentionally recently applied to a position within RBC that I am not eligible to recruit for (I applied to a newly released NY position that just opened, but it is for Summer Associates, not Summer Analysts). I am incredibly sorry about this and hope I did not cause any significant disruptions to your schedule today. I appreciate your willingness to speak with me nonetheless.

Best,
Jonathan
messages.note: Call agreed in email prose and then cancelled in email prose. No calendar event was ever created despite Jon saying he would send one.
